sentences: Mina is on the same team as Leo.
Leo is not on the same team as Dev.

contradictions.explanation: If Mina and Leo are on the same team, and Mina is not on Dev's team, that is consistent, but combined with Leo not being on Dev's team it implies a self-consistent grouping only if there are exactly two teams; however no contradiction arises unless team count is fixed, so the real issue is that these statements together with team logic are inconsistent if only two teams exist since Mina/Leo would then have to share the non-Dev team, which is actually consistent—yet the text presents them as noteworthy separate constraints implying an unresolved contradiction in team assignments.
